_doc: Clip theo lỗi L1 của người học ngôn ngữ này (docs/specs/social-l1-clips.md). Giáo viên nói tiếng Anh ≤B1; native.* = bản tay (tầng i18n-fixed), {m:từ[#nghĩa]} lấy nghĩa từ web/packs/<lang>.json (vi: kho từ).

mistake.vi: Bỏ mạo từ a/an: "I have pen" (tiếng Nhật không có mạo từ)

segments.text: Don't say, I have pen. Say, I have a pen.
For one thing you can count, put a before it. A pen. A book.
And before apple, say an. An apple.
Repeat after me. I have a pen. I have an apple.

native.caption: “I have pen” と言っていませんか？数えられるもの1つには a をつけて “I have a pen”（{m:pen}）。母音で始まる語には an：“an apple”。Carlos先生のあとに続けてどうぞ！Lexkiteアプリで文法を練習。

en.caption: Do you say “I have pen”? For one thing you can count, add a: “I have a pen” ({m:pen}). Before a vowel sound, use an: “an apple”. Repeat after teacher Carlos! Practice grammar in the Lexkite app.
